name: Veloc
description: Veloc was a planet in the fourth orbit around the star Velm. The first of two gas giants in the Velm system, it was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veloc was orbited by thirty-three moons, 281 asteroid moonlets, and a planetary ring.
